draft.subject: your legal operations hire
draft.body:
Hi Hannah,

Saw Greystone Bury is hiring a legal operations manager to own intake, the practice management system and the firm's approach to legal technology. That is a big remit for one person. The AI part of it usually raises the hardest questions, because every tool the firm trials has to be checked for where client data goes, who can see it and whether it is kept for training, and those checks take time away from the rest of the role.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Is this something you are weighing up? Would it help to compare notes on a short call?

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture

evidence.text: Legal Operations Manager. Own our intake process, practice management system and the firm's approach to legal technology.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
The Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) warning notice of 17 August 2026 allows client data into AI tools only with contractual, technical and organisational safeguards.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
